column1: Base URL of the RabbitMQ management API, for example http://rabbitmq:15672. Leave empty to derive it from the amqp host in app/etc/env.php on port 15672. Credentials are always taken from env.php, never entered here.
column2: Base URL of the RabbitMQ management API, for example http://rabbitmq:15672. Leave empty to derive it from the amqp host in app/etc/env.php on port 15672. Credentials are always taken from env.php, never entered here.

column1: URL of the imgproxy Prometheus endpoint, reachable from the PHP container. Start imgproxy with IMGPROXY_PROMETHEUS_BIND (for example ":4594") to publish it. This is a second listener and cannot share the port imgproxy serves images on, so it is not the IMGPROXY_BIND address. Metrics are served from any path on that binding, so the path below is a convention rather than a requirement. The OpenTelemetry metrics switch pushes to a collector instead and exposes nothing to read here. Leave empty to disable the imgproxy probe.
